title: Bridgeport Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Bridgeport is only a 1 minute walk (176 yards) to the beach in Seaside, Florida and just a 7 minute walk to downtown Seaside with over 35 shops and restaurants only a short walk from your front door! Prime location, park views, for a perfect family escape!
description_expanded: Description30 ROBERT'S WAY1 QUEEN, 1 BUNK BED, 1 FULL - ( Sleeps 6)Welcome to Bridgeport | A Classic Rosewalk Retreat in Seaside, FloridaTucked into the charming Rosewalk area of Seaside, FL, Bridgeport is a cheerful pink beach bungalow that captures the spirit of original Seaside living. Sleeping up to six guests, this inviting cottage offers a prime location just 176 yards (a 3-minute walk) to the beach and an easy 7-minute stroll to Seaside’s Central Square, where more than 40 shops and restaurants await. Positioned along Robert’s Way and backing up to Rosewalk Park, Bridgeport offers a rare blend of walkability, privacy, and peaceful park views in true old Seaside style.Outdoor Living Overlooking Rosewalk ParkOne of Bridgeport’s most charming features is its screened rear porch, overlooking the sandy paths and shaded trees of Rosewalk Park—a hidden gem within Seaside. With bar-top seating for two and a porch swing, this laid-back space is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or unwinding in the evening while the kids play below. The park setting adds a quiet, tucked-away feel while still being just moments from the energy of town.Comfortable First-Floor LivingInside, the first level offers an easy, open living space with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV—ideal for gathering after a day at the beach. The kitchen sits just off the living area and includes bar-top seating for four, creating a simple, functional space for casual meals and conversation. The layout encourages time spent together, whether relaxing indoors or heading out for the day.Two Bedrooms & Flexible Sleeping SpacesThe first floor includes two bedrooms for added convenience. The queen guest bedroom features natural light, a flat-screen TV, storage space, and a private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. The second bedroom is a bunk room that sleeps two and includes a window seat, closet space, and a loft area accessed by a ship’s ladder—well-suited for kids. A nearby full bathroom with a shower serves this space.Upstairs, a secondary living area provides an additional spot to relax, with a sofa and cushioned seating. Just off this space is a cozy sleeping nook with a full bed, accommodating two more guests. Step outside to the open-air upper balcony with Adirondack-style seating for two, where you can take in the quiet park views and coastal breeze.A True Old Seaside StayWith its unbeatable location, park-side setting, and classic cottage feel, Bridgeport is a great fit for families or groups looking to experience Seaside the way it’s always been. Walk to the beach, bike through town, and return to a colorful bungalow that reflects the charm and character of original Seaside living.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES:870 square feet of comfortable coastal living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on Scenic 30A176 yards (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach access and a 7-minute walk to the Seaside AmphitheaterAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two bedroom and larger homes issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR24-001467
